comparator.note: The comparator is the extract-first memory server whose harness provider key hashes to registry_key_sha256. Its package and env names are derived at runtime from that key, so no product name is written in this repository.

lifebench.why: The harness loader reads this file from the dataset's main branch, which moved it in commit a975d4a; this is the last commit that has it (2,003 questions, 10 users, as in the committed rows).

dataset_note: Other datasets download through the harness loaders; every cell id includes a sha256 over the scheduled questions and their documents, so a changed upstream file makes a new cell instead of a silent rerun.
